body_axes: +X forward, +Y right, +Z down; origin the aircraft root / physics CG
measured_on: the game's own placement on extended gear
rule: The cockpit camera sits exactly at the seated pilot's eye, with no offset. The PRIMARY seat is the solo seat: the rear on a tandem, the front on the 2-33, the left on the 172. Eyes stay above the forward fuselage top line. These points are also the basis for VR.
proposal_note: v4 came from lane/codex-eyepoints aab015b, which is marked proposed/requires_approval. Ty's v5 supersedes it. The Great Lakes rear in particular was computed with the aeroplane 0.223 m low and sat inside the tub, which is why all 808 of its true-eye rays were blocked.
